title: WF03 OBS-03 HTTP env blocker: aggregate integration runner masked MUST OBS-03 evidence behind unrelated BPM_TEST_URL skips
summary: OBS-03 verification was blocked by aggregate integration execution that still ran unrelated HTTP tests requiring BPM_TEST_URL, which produced skip noise and non-actionable output for MUST OBS-03 evidence. A dedicated OBS-03 integration build step was added for deterministic pass/fail, and OBS-03 test fixture cleanup was corrected to avoid mutating immutable audit_entries during setup.

root_cause.details: `zig build test-integration` executes the whole integration suite and includes HTTP tests that skip when BPM_TEST_URL is absent. That output masked requirement-specific evidence for OBS-03. In OBS-03 tests, setup also attempted DELETE against immutable `audit_entries`, making fixture behavior non-deterministic under repeated runs.

changes: Added `zig build test-integration-obs03` in build.zig to run only tests/integration/obs03_audit_log_test.zig with existing integration imports.
Removed invalid cleanup calls that attempted DELETE on immutable audit_entries in TC-OBS-03-INT-04/05.
Added deterministic guard cleanup for prior fault-injection hook artifacts before immutable/pagination insert assertions.

prevention: For MUST requirement verification, use requirement-scoped integration entrypoints instead of aggregate suites that include unrelated env-gated tests.
Do not use DELETE-based cleanup helpers on immutable tables in integration fixtures.
